summary: Enhance your knowledge with our Food and Nutrition Security Training Course. Learn essential skills to tackle food insecurity and promote healthy eating.
lede: Food and nutrition security assessment connects household and population evidence to decisions about needs, responses and results. The course is for analysts, programme managers and response coordinators who work with food, market, health, livelihood or nutrition data. Participants practice interpreting FIES, dietary-diversity and IPC evidence, mapping market and vulnerability pressures, and designing nutrition-sensitive responses with measurable indicators.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess food insecurity, plan nutrition-sensitive programmes, coordinate humanitarian or development responses, and report evidence to funders, leadership, and operational partners. It suits intermediate to advanced practitioners who already work with programme, market, health, livelihood, or nutrition data.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop with spreadsheet capability. No coding experience is required. TrainingCred can provide structured practice datasets, assessment templates, indicator reference sheets, response-planning worksheets, and dashboard examples. Participants using Power BI should have access to the desktop application before the course, although the core exercises can use Excel where organizational licensing or installation constraints apply.
